llm.evidence: a Q Exactive HF mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific) coupled to an RSLC system
Multiplex quantitative stable isotope labeling in cell culture (SILAC) was used
Samp3ylated proteins were purified by α-Flag chromatography
Eluting peptides were analyzed in DDA mode
triggered for HCD fragmentation with a normalized collision energy of 30
cysteine side chains were blocked by methyl methanethiosulfonate (MMTS) treatment
